strings.name: José Manuel Barroso
strings.summary: Barroso moved from law and academia into Portuguese government, serving as foreign minister and premier. Commission president in 2004–2014, he worked on treaty reform and financial-crisis responses. His later Goldman Sachs appointment drew revolving-door criticism. He chaired Gavi in 2021–2025 and became FLAD president in January 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His Portuguese and Commission leadership influenced EU enlargement, financial-crisis responses and multilateral cooperation.
